title: AI Trust & Security Control Plane
subtitle: Shared trust, security, and launch-readiness posture for governed Onyx (RAG) and Dify (Autonomous Agents) runtime access.
hero_copy: This dashboard-first control plane is the runtime-access decision surface across two governed AI runtime classes: Onyx for retrieval-grounded RAG and Dify for autonomous agent orchestration. The homepage states the decision, and drill-down sections provide the evidence.
landing_steps: Confirm trust proof freshness and completeness
Review the top failing or missing security control
Open drill-down sections for detailed evidence
repo_description_suggestion: Decision-first dashboard for governed Onyx (RAG) and Dify (Autonomous Agents) runtime readiness, trust proof, and security posture.
